## Summary

**PCMPccW** (Vector compare): Word-by-word vector compare.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `4 x b – a → condition → d` |
| Syntax | `PCMPEQW <vea>,b,d`<br>`PCMPHIW <vea>,b,d`<br>`PCMPGEW <vea>,b,d`<br>`PCMPGTW <vea>,b,d` |
| Short | Word-by-word vector compare. |
| Condition codes | not affected. Register d holds the outcome. False = 0. |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–4 | `0010` |
| 2 | 3–1 | CC |
| 2 | 0 | `1` |

- CC:
- eq = 000 (ne)
- hi = 001 (ls) unsigned
- ge = 110 (lt) signed
- gt = 111 (le) signed
- hs (lo) unsigned is not implemented

### Example

```asm
    pcmpeqw	e0,e1,e3	; e1 == e0 ? → e3
    pcmphiw	e0,e1,e2	; e1  >  e0 ? → e2 (unsigned)
    por		e3,e2,e2	; ( e1 == e0 ) or ( e1  > e0 ) →  e1 >= e0
```

```asm
    bsel		e2,d1,e8	; if (e1>=e0) then replace e8 with d1
    ; or
    pand		e2,d1,e8	; if (e1>=e0) then  e8=d1 else e8=0
    ; or
    pandn	e2,d1,e8	; if (e1 < e0) then  e8=d1 else e8=0
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no PCMPccW. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use PCMPHSW: it is not implemented. Combine PCMPEQW and PCMPHIW with POR.
